integrity: An analytic infinite-state proof and explicit finite polynomial positivity certificate accompany a standalone symbolic checker. The exact boundary is separately treated. This is a same-model scientific review, not independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: The exact adjacent-minor sign theorem concerns the first two output columns and consecutive preceding states; global TP2 at the admissibility endpoint, all higher minors, and reversibility remain unclassified. Historical priority is provisional because some older primary full texts were not accessible.
title: A critical likelihood-ratio reversal in the Poisson–Lindley minification chain
